profile.headline: Lead Web Developer at TEKsystems
profile.summary:
I'm an experienced Full stack developer with knowledge across multiple languages and platforms. I love CSS but believe in utilizing existing frameworks to prevent misuse of CSS custom classes. I've developed several Greenfield applications from scratch,, using both Bootstrap and Tailwind. 

I love learning new skills and languages in my spare time and try to  stay part of modding communities within games that I frequently play.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
Build Angular Applications
Attend high-level meetings to gather requirements
Refine work for team members to work on with Product Team
Guide other developers on team
Use AI coding tools to assist in development
Manage Approval in CI/CD pipelines for deployments between environments
Coordinate with several other teams to align on common interests
